amanda_sales: Quick sync - Prospect (ZenCloud) POC next week. They require SAML SSO + SCIM provisioning + RBAC group mappings. Can we confirm a 2-week POC scope?
ben_ae: Yes for SAML and SCIM 2.0 delta. RBAC via SCIM groups or SAML group claim mapping. Manual CSV import possible for initial user seeding.
raj_engineering: Hosted domain proofing supports TXT or CNAME (CNAME preferred). Private supports customer KMS/HSM; need key ARN and access during onboarding.
liz_seclead: Security: we support signed assertions (RSA-SHA256). Encrypted assertions are NOT enabled on Hosted today — only Private or special test env.
amanda_sales: ZenCloud says encrypted assertions are mandatory. Does that block Hosted POC?
ben_ae: It does. Options: run a Private eval or provision a short-lived dedicated test instance with assertion encryption (adds ~2-3 business days).
raj_engineering: SCIM endpoints: /scim/v2/Users and /Groups, delta sync. Example: curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.example/scim/v2/Groups" -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"displayName":"eng","members":[{"value":"u-123"}]}'
liz_seclead: I'll draft a security Q&A snippet (signing algos, TLS ciphers, audit log retention 90d, SOC2 link) and call out Hosted limitation on encrypted assertions.
amanda_sales: Need a one-pager checklist for IdOps (SAML metadata fields, DNS steps, SCIM token, mapping options) by EOD Friday.
ben_ae: I'll assemble one-pager + price ballpark for Dedicated vs Hosted and include management API billing note for SCIM calls.
infra_bot: deploy status: no auth-related deploys last 24h.
amanda_sales: Great — I'll confirm whether encrypted assertions are an absolute requirement and loop back. :thumbsup:
